exposure: planned mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean)
outcome: composite neonatal outcome (APGAR <7 at 5 minutes, NICU admission, resuscitation, birth trauma, neonatal complications, or death before discharge)
cohort: 177 twin deliveries at Tenwek Hospital, Kenya from April 1, 2017, to March 30, 2023, where twin A presented cephalic
finding: Planned cesarean deliveries in twin pregnancies with twin A presenting cephalic were associated with fewer adverse neonatal outcomes compared to planned vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: recorded and categorized but specific values not provided
